title: watcher.query_watches
description:
Query watches.

Get all registered watches in a paginated manner and optionally filter watches by a query.

Note that only the `_id` and `metadata.*` fields are queryable or sortable.

from.description:
The offset from the first result to fetch.
It must be non-negative.

size.description:
The number of hits to return.
It must be non-negative.

query.description: A query that filters the watches to be returned.

sort.description: One or more fields used to sort the search results.

search_after.description: Retrieve the next page of hits using a set of sort values from the previous page.
